crumb: Breadcrumb in the header for the Issues page (the team's issue tracker).
not-found: Breadcrumb in the header when the address names no issue.
page.title: Title of the Issues page (the team's issue tracker).
page.counts: Line under the Issues page's title: how many issues are open, in progress and done.
page.tracker: Line under the Issues page's title while the list loads.
page.select: Button that turns on Select mode, to change several issues at once.
page.view: Accessible name of the pair of buttons that switch between the board and the list.
page.board-view: Button (an icon) that shows the issues as a kanban board, one column per status.
page.list-view: Button (an icon) that shows the issues as a list grouped by status.
page.new: Button at the top of the Issues page that opens the form to report a new issue.
move.done: Toast after an issue moved; {{key}} is its key (CB-12), {{status}} the new status's name.
move.failed: Toast when moving an issue failed; {{key}} is its key.
move.undone: Under move.failed: the issue went back to where it was.
move.button: Accessible name of the button (an icon) that opens the menu to move an issue to another status.
move.menu: Heading of that menu; {{key}} is the issue's key, the statuses follow.
batch.toolbar: Accessible name of the bar of actions on the selected issues.
batch.select-all: Button that selects every issue shown; the count is how many that is.
batch.clear: Button in the Select-mode bar that unselects all issues.
batch.status: Menu button (admins only) in the Select-mode bar that sets the status of the selected issues.
batch.priority: Menu button (admins only) in the Select-mode bar that sets the priority of the selected issues.
batch.labels: Menu button (admins only) in the Select-mode bar that adds or removes a label on the selected issues.
batch.set-status: Accessible name of the menu button that sets the selected issues' status.
batch.set-priority: Accessible name of the menu button that sets the selected issues' priority.
batch.set-labels: Accessible name of the menu button that adds or removes a label on the selected issues.
batch.add-label: Submenu in the Labels menu: the label to add to the selected issues.
batch.remove-label: Submenu in the Labels menu: the label to remove from the selected issues.
batch.moved: What a batch change did, before batch.changed or batch.failed; {{status}} is a status's name.
batch.priority-set: What a batch change did; {{priority}} is a priority's name.
batch.added: What a batch change did; {{label}} is a label's name.
batch.removed: What a batch change did; {{label}} is a label's name.
batch.failed: Toast: {{what}} is a batch change (batch.moved…), the count how many issues it didn't change.
batch.changed: Toast: {{what}} is a batch change (batch.moved…), the count how many issues it changed.
batch.nothing: Toast when no selected issue needed the change.
batch.refused: The reason given when the server refused a change without saying why.
batch.row-failed: One line under batch.failed: {{key}} is an issue's key, {{reason}} why it failed.
toolbar.search: Accessible name of the search box over the issues.
toolbar.search-placeholder: Placeholder of the search box over the issues.
toolbar.dot-requests: Toggle that shows only the issues socios (AI agents) filed to ask for a capability. "Socio" is a product noun.
toolbar.wont-fix: Menu item (a checkbox) that also shows the "Won't fix" column on the board.
toolbar.clear: Button in the toolbar that clears every filter and the search.
toolbar.shown: How many issues the filters show, of all of them.
toolbar.total: How many issues there are, with no filter.
toolbar.chosen: Accessible name of a filter button with values chosen: {{facet}} is the filter's name (toolbar.facet.*), {{values}} the chosen values.
toolbar.facet.status: Each toolbar.facet.* key: a filter button's name.
toolbar.facet.priority: Filter button's name: the issue's priority.
toolbar.facet.kind: Filter button's name: what sort of issue it is (bug, feature...).
toolbar.facet.area: Filter button's name: the part of the product an issue is about.
toolbar.facet.label: Filter button's name: the issue's labels.
toolbar.facet.component: The plugin or app an issue is about.
toolbar.filter.status: Each toolbar.filter.* key: the accessible name of a filter button with nothing chosen.
toolbar.filter.priority: Accessible name of the Priority filter button in the toolbar over the issues; it opens a list of priorities to show.
toolbar.filter.kind: Accessible name of the Kind filter button in the toolbar over the issues (bug, feature and so on).
toolbar.filter.area: Accessible name of the Area filter button in the toolbar over the issues: the part of the product an issue is about.
toolbar.filter.label: Accessible name of the Label filter button in the toolbar over the issues.
toolbar.filter.component: Accessible name of the Component filter button in the toolbar over the issues: the plugin or app an issue is about.
toolbar.clear-facet.status: Each toolbar.clear-facet.* key: menu item that clears that filter's chosen values.
toolbar.clear-facet.priority: Accessible name of the small button on the Priority filter that removes the priorities chosen in it.
toolbar.clear-facet.kind: Accessible name of the small button on the Kind filter that removes the kinds chosen in it.
toolbar.clear-facet.area: Accessible name of the small button on the Area filter that removes the areas chosen in it.
toolbar.clear-facet.label: Accessible name of the small button on the Label filter that removes the labels chosen in it.
toolbar.clear-facet.component: Accessible name of the small button on the Component filter that removes the components chosen in it.
board.column-count: Read by screen readers after a column's status name, so the leading comma joins them: how many issues it holds.
board.drop: In an empty column while an issue is dragged over it.
board.empty: In a board column that holds no issues.
board.select: Accessible name of an issue's checkbox in Select mode; {{key}} is its key.
list.empty: In the list view when no issue matches the filters.
votes.count: How many people voted for an issue, inside votes.vote and votes.withdraw.
votes.vote: Accessible name of the vote button; {{key}} is the issue's key, {{votes}} votes.count.
votes.withdraw: Accessible name of the vote button once you voted; {{key}} is the issue's key, {{votes}} votes.count.
votes.vote-hint: Tooltip of the vote button on an issue you haven't voted for.
votes.withdraw-hint: Tooltip of the vote button once you voted; clicking it removes your vote.
votes.failed: Toast when your vote couldn't be saved.
votes.sort: Toggle that sorts each column by votes, most first.
votes.sort-hint: Tooltip of the Most votes toggle.
badge.demand: Badge on a socio's capability request: how many socio and person pairs asked for it.
badge.demand-hint: Tooltip of that badge. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent).
badge.blocked: Badge on an issue that waits for other open issues: how many.
badge.assigned: Tooltip of the assignee's initials; {{name}} is their name.
